picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the DOE-led Genesis Mission signals a whole-of-government commitment (15+ federal agencies, launched by executive order) to AI-accelerated science — the broadest policy signal of the week.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's haul of 13 lead projects plus 30+ partnerships makes it the single largest Genesis Mission award of the week, cementing a national lab as a hub for AI-driven science.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge National Lab leading nine projects and contributing to 32 more shows the scale at which DOE is concentrating Genesis Mission resources at its national labs.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's six lead projects and 17 partnerships further underscore how deeply the national lab system is being woven into the federal AI-for-science strategy.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as CSO, is a major private-sector bet on AI-driven materials discovery bridging academia and industry.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI/robotics partnership, backed by €1.6M and built around researcher exchanges, deepens a flagship transatlantic academic collaboration.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's Apertus 1.5 release advances the case for fully open, multimodal large language models trained on European public supercomputing infrastructure.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: A new deep-learning model from CMU, Pitt, and UW linking 3D genome architecture to Alzheimer's disease is a concrete scientific advance with direct implications for understanding the disease.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node marks a major infrastructure investment in automated, AI-driven science.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Boston University's matching $20M NSF cloud-lab award, focused on biotech, extends the same national automated-science network to a second flagship node.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network
